title: Q2 Results Highlights 27th Oct: Bajaj Auto Q2 PAT up 35%, Maruti Suzuki & Cipla profit down, ACC, Mazagon Dock PAT tumbles, Honeywell Automation PAT up, L&T, Vedanta Iron, Waaree Energies, SAIL, SBI L
text:
Two investors are working together with analyzing the stock data graphs in the paper and viewing the data on the laptop screen. | Photo Credit: wutwhanfoto

Q2 Results Today, 27th October 2026 Highlights: Find all the latest Q2 results 2026 updates of Larsen & Toubro, Maruti Suzuki India, Bajaj Auto, Cipla, Tata Steel, Vedanta Iron And Steel, Waaree Energies, Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders, ACC, JSW Infrastructure, JSW Cement, Steel Authority of India, Tata Capital, SBI Life Insurance Company, Max Financial Services.

GAINERS: Tata Consumer, Paytm, Sona BLW, ITC Hotels, BOM, KFin Tech, Ather Energy

Stock market live updates | Stay tuned to businessline for more

Maruti Suzuki: Standalone PAT declined 27% to ₹2414.9 cr

Bajaj Auto: Standalone PAT rose 35.2% y-o-y to ₹3,353.76 crore in Q2FY27.

ACC: Standalone profit tumbles to ₹101 crore in Q2

Indiamart Intermesh: Profit rises 27.4% y-o-y to ₹107.3 cr in Q2FY27

Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders’ standalone net profit tumbles ₹340.20 cr

Radico Khaitan: Logs 66% y-o-y increase in standalone net profit at ₹230.87 cr

Net profit growth in second quarter FY 27 was led by 16% growth in operating revenue to ₹78,750 crore; lower finance costs, treasury income and efficiency in working capital also contributed to gains

EBITDA was up 11% at ₹674 crore and the company recorded net cash of ₹1,693 crore and gross debt of ₹7,292 crore

ACC nets 92% fall to ₹93 crore in Q2 on higher costs, lower sales; revenue down 5% to ₹5,666 crore amid MSA impact with Ambuja.

For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, Waaree Energies reported consolidated net profit attributable to owners of ₹719 crore, compared with ₹842 crore in the year-ago period.

As per a statement by TVS Credit, the NBFC clocked a net profit of ₹243 crores for Q2FY27, a growth of 19% compared to the same period last year

Coca-Cola India posts strong Q3 CY26 volume growth amid affordability and premiumisation, while exploring Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings IPO plans.

Tata Capital posts 51% Q2 profit rise to ₹1,660 cr, with 23% NII growth and a ₹3 lakh crore loan book expansion.

Bajaj Auto’s consolidated net profit attributable to shareholders rose 61.9% year-on-year to ₹3,436.10 crore in the July–September quarter, while revenue increased 59.7% to ₹25,125.56 crore

Jubilant Ingrevia posts 60% Q2 profit rise to ₹111 cr and signs 40% stake in ZettaOne, with revenues up and EBITDA growth.

AWL Agri Business Ltd on Tuesday reported a 2% drop in consolidated net profit to ₹239.39 crore for the quarter ended September, despite higher revenue.

Its net profit stood at ₹244.85 crore in the year-ago period.

Total income rose to ₹22,271.25 crore in the second quarter of this fiscal year from ₹17,525.61 crore in the corresponding period of the preceding year, according to a regulatory filing.

AWL Agri Business Ltd sells edible oil and other food items under various brands, including Fortune. (PTI)

Bajaj Auto Q2 FY27: 35% profit rise to ₹3,354 cr, ₹20,003 cr revenue, strong domestic/exports growth; EV/ICE mix improving.

Revenue from operations grew 32.5% year-on-year to ₹33.98 crore in Q2 FY27, compared to ₹25.64 crore in the same quarter last year

ACC posts 91% quarterly profit drop on higher fuel costs, weak sales; cement volumes slip as costs rise.

Maruti Suzuki’s Q2 profit fell short of estimates at ₹2,415 crore as expenses rose, despite a 26% increase in revenue to ₹53,340 crore.

Raymond reported standalone profit of Rs 1.59 crore in Q2FY27 compared to Rs 2.85 crore loss in Q2FY26.

Honeywell Automation reported net profit of Rs 133.7 crore in Q2FY27 as against Rs 119.5 crore in Q2FY26.

Kirloskar Brothers reported standalone PAT of Rs 54.4 crore in Q2FY27 as against Rs 37.6 crore in Q2FY26.

During the quarter, Maruti registered its highest-ever Net Sales of INR 506,155 million against INR 401,358million in the same period of the previous year

Benchmarks settled marginally flat. Sensex settled at 73,598.67, (-8.08 pts or 0.01%), and Nifty 50 slipped 3.45 pts or 0.02% to 22,749.75.

Maruti Suzuki India’s standalone PAT declined 27% to Rs 2414.9 crore in Q2FY27 from Rs 3302.8 crore in Q2FY26.

Bajaj Auto’s standalone PAT rose 35.2% y-o-y to Rs 3,353.76 crore in Q2FY27 from Rs 2,479.74 crore in Q2FY26.

Indiamart Intermesh reported 27.4% y-o-y increase in standalone net profit to Rs 107.3 crore in Q2FY27 from Rs 84.2 crore in Q2FY26.

Shares surged 5% to Rs 1,637.40 on the NSE.

Revenue from operations rose 29.9% year-on-year to ₹401.8 crore, EBITDA grew 18.7% to ₹161 crore, though margins contracted to 40.1% from 43.9% a year earlier

“Our growth remains trade-led, in line with our strategy, while we continue to strengthenthe institutional business through a comprehensive solutions approach with a focus onvalue and profitability. Industry demand remains supportive and is expected tostrengthen post-monsoon, aided by housing, infrastructure and capital expenditure,while improving pricing momentum should moderate the impact of elevated fuel andenergy costs.”

- Vinod Bahety, Whole-time Director and CEO, ACC Limited

• Q2 cement sales volume stood at 9.7 MnT, Trade share increased by 7 pp YoY to78%, while premium products accounted for 47% of trade sales, up 3 pp QoQ,Blended cement share improved to 85% from 78% in Q2 FY’26.

• Revenue from operations stood at Rs 5,689 Cr; Operating EBITDA was Rs 401Cr, with a margin of 7.0% and EBITDA of Rs 414 per tonne (higher MSA volumeswith Ambuja).

• Ready-Mix Concrete achieved quarterly volume of 1.07 Mn m³ in Q2 FY’27,registering 19% YoY growth.

Transport Corporation of India’s standalone net profit dipped to Rs 91.7 crore in Q2FY27 compared to Rs 87.8 crore in Q2FY26.

Board approved issuance of NCDs aggregating to Rs 300 crore; and approved the appointment of Mr. Bhudev Bhushan Giri as CEO – Designate, TCI Seaways Division and Senior Management Personnel of the Company.
